deployments_detail.use: Cadence internally deploys and supports AI-assisted software development tools (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) for its engineering workforce, per a dedicated internal GenAI Tools Support Engineer role owning deployment, configuration and end-user support. [Anthropic Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot]
Cerebrus AI chip-design optimizer + JedAI data platform + Cerebrus AI Studio (agentic SoC design); Cadence.AI portfolio

Cadence Cerebrus Intelligent Chip Explorer, a reinforcement-learning AI tool that automates chip design flow optimization, deployed by MediaTek to shrink die area by 5% and reduce power by more than 6% on a floorplan optimization run. [Cadence (Cerebrus), reinforcement learning]

Renesas adopted Cadence Cerebrus for AI-driven digital flow optimization and floorplan exploration on an advanced-node CPU design, improving design performance by more than 10%. [Cadence (Cerebrus), reinforcement learning]

Samsung Austin Research Center (SARC) used Cadence Cerebrus AI Studio, the agentic AI multi-block SoC implementation tool, achieving 4X productivity in chip design. [Cadence (Cerebrus AI Studio), agentic AI]

Cadence Verisium AI-driven verification platform (AI-powered debug, root-cause analysis, coverage optimization) deployed to accelerate debug productivity at Renesas. [Cadence (Verisium), machine learning]

Danfoss deployed Cadence Allegro X AI (cloud AI for automated PCB component placement and routing), achieving a 96% reduction in component placement time and a 64% overall reduction in total process time. [Cadence (Allegro X AI)]
deployments_detail.value: 96% placement time reduction, 64% total process time reduction

deployments_detail.use: Wistron deployed Cadence Optimality Intelligent System Explorer (AI-driven multiphysics electromagnetic optimization) alongside Clarity 3D Solver to accelerate product development. [Cadence (Optimality Explorer)]

Cadence ChipStack AI Super Agent, an agentic workflow that autonomously creates and verifies chip designs from specifications, claiming 10X productivity and, at Level-5 autonomy, 40X faster RTL validation. Powered by NVIDIA (NemoClaw open-source stack). [Cadence (ChipStack AI Super Agent) + NVIDIA]

Cadence Millennium M2000 Supercomputer integrating NVIDIA HGX B200 and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for AI-accelerated EDA, CFD digital twins and life-sciences simulation; NVIDIA committed to purchase 10 Millennium systems for its own chip design workflows. [Cadence (Millennium M2000) + NVIDIA Blackwell]
deployments_detail.value: up to 80X performance vs prior CPU-based system

deployments_detail.use: Cadence Molecular Sciences (OpenEye) integrated NVIDIA BioNeMo NIM microservices into its Orion cloud molecular design platform for AI-driven drug discovery (3D de novo protein structure prediction, small-molecule generative AI, molecular property prediction). [Cadence Molecular Sciences (Orion) + NVIDIA BioNeMo]

Cadence JedAI (Joint Enterprise Data and AI) Platform, the cross-Cadence big-data/generative-AI analytics foundation ('EDA 2.0') that unifies RTL, layout, constraints and verification data so AI models can be trained and reused to accelerate AI-driven chip design. [Cadence (JedAI Platform), generative AI]
